author: Yffe
content: Fix: weave referenced struct/enum decls into check::item_subprogram (the #52-analog). New reachable_adt_deps collects ADT type names from the checked item + woven fn-deps (param/return Type::Named/Box-recurse, contract req/ens/dec, body StructLit/Match/Pattern::Enum/Struct/Is/Field, variant->enum resolution), then a cycle-safe fixed point follows weaved struct/enum FIELD types through the type graph (recursive Box<List> terminates). item_subprogram gains adt_deps woven FIRST (decls before fn); threaded through mutation_score/strengthen_certificate so ADT mutants still lower. Single file forge/src/check.rs (+ a clippy doc-rewrap in the test). L2/cache-key keep empty (byte-stable). #69 fold-generality NOT touched.
